title: Diffusion Factor Models: Generating High-Dimensional Returns with Factor Structure
summary: Financial scenario simulation is essential for risk management and portfolio optimization, yet it remains challenging especially in high-dimensional and small data settings common in finance. We propose a diffusion factor model that integrates latent factor structure into generative diffusion processes, bridging econometrics with modern generative AI to address the challenges of the curse of dimensionality and data scarcity in financial simulation. By exploiting the low-dimensional factor structure inherent in asset returns, we decompose the score function--a key component in diffusion models--using time-varying orthogonal projections, and this decomposition is incorporated into the design of neural network architectures. We derive rigorous statistical guarantees, establishing nonasymptotic error bounds for both score estimation at O(d^{5/2} n^{-2/(k+5)}) and generated distribution at O(d^{5/4} n^{-1/2(k+5)}), primarily driven by the intrinsic factor dimension k rather than the number of assets d, surpassing the dimension-dependent limits in the classical nonparametric statistics literature and making the framework viable for markets with thousands of assets. Numerical studies confirm superior performance in latent subspace recovery under small data regimes. Empirical analysis demonstrates the economic significance of our framework in constructing mean-variance optimal portfolios and factor portfolios. This work presents the first theoretical integration of factor structure with diffusion models, offering a principled approach for high-dimensional financial simulation with limited data. Our code is available at https://github.com/xymmmm00/diffusion_factor_model.

title: Learning Operators by Regularized Stochastic Gradient Descent with Operator-valued Kernels
summary: We consider a class of statistical inverse problems involving the estimation of a regression operator from a Polish space to a separable Hilbert space, where the target lies in a vector-valued reproducing kernel Hilbert space induced by an operator-valued kernel. To address the associated ill-posedness, we analyze regularized stochastic gradient descent (SGD) algorithms in both online and finite-horizon settings. The former uses polynomially decaying step sizes and regularization parameters, while the latter adopts fixed values. Under suitable structural and distributional assumptions, we establish dimension-independent bounds for prediction and estimation errors. The resulting convergence rates are near-optimal in expectation, and we also derive high-probability estimates that imply almost sure convergence. Our analysis introduces a general technique for obtaining high-probability guarantees in infinite-dimensional settings. Possible extensions to broader kernel classes and encoder-decoder structures are briefly discussed.

title: Simulation of Multivariate Extremes: a Wasserstein-Aitchison GAN approach
summary: Economically responsible mitigation of multivariate extreme risks-such as extreme rainfall over large areas, large simultaneous variations in many stock prices, or widespread breakdowns in transportation systems-requires assessing the resilience of the systems under plausible stress scenarios. This paper uses Extreme Value Theory (EVT) to develop a new approach to simulating such multivariate extreme events. Specifically, we assume that after transformation to a standard scale the distribution of the random phenomenon of interest is multivariate regular varying and use this to provide a sampling procedure for extremes on the original scale. Our procedure combines a Wasserstein-Aitchison Generative Adversarial Network (WA-GAN) to simulate the tail dependence structure on the standard scale with joint modeling of the univariate marginal tails on the original scale. The WA-GAN procedure relies on the angular measure-encoding the distribution on the unit simplex of the angles of extreme observations-after transformation to Aitchison coordinates, which allows the Wasserstein-GAN algorithm to be run in a linear space. Our method is applied both to simulated data under various tail dependence scenarios and to a financial data set from the Kenneth French Data Library. The proposed algorithm demonstrates strong performance compared to existing alternatives in the literature, both in capturing tail dependence structures and in generating accurate new extreme observations.

title: Convergence Rates of Constrained Expected Improvement
summary: Constrained Bayesian optimization (CBO) methods have seen significant success in black-box optimization with constraints. One of the most commonly used CBO methods is the constrained expected improvement (CEI) algorithm. CEI is a natural extension of expected improvement (EI) when constraints are incorporated. However, the theoretical convergence rate of CEI has not been established. In this work, we study the convergence rate of CEI by analyzing its simple regret upper bound. First, we show that when the objective function $f$ and constraint function $c$ are assumed to each lie in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS), CEI achieves the convergence rates of $\mathcal{O} \left(t^{-\frac{1}{2}}\log^{\frac{d+1}{2}}(t) \right) \ \text{and }\ \mathcal{O}\left(t^{\frac{-ν}{2ν+d}} \log^{\fracν{2ν+d}}(t)\right)$ for the commonly used squared exponential and Matérn kernels ($ν>\frac{1}{2}$), respectively. Second, we show that when $f$ is assumed to be sampled from Gaussian processes (GPs), CEI achieves similar convergence rates with a high probability. Numerical experiments are performed to validate the theoretical analysis.

AI.title_translation: 约束期望改进的收敛速率
AI.tldr: 首次理论证明了约束期望改进（CEI）算法的收敛速度，确定了其在RKHS和GP假设下的具体收敛率，填补了相关理论空白。
AI.motivation: 约束贝叶斯优化（CBO）方法在带约束的黑盒优化中取得了显著成功，其中约束期望改进（CEI）算法是最常用的CBO方法之一，它是期望改进（EI）在引入约束后的自然扩展。然而，CEI算法的理论收敛速率尚未建立。
AI.method: 通过分析约束期望改进（CEI）算法的简单遗憾上界来研究其收敛率。具体地，在函数位于再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）的假设下，推导了平方指数核和Matérn核对应的收敛率；并在函数从高斯过程（GP）采样的假设下，证明了高概率下的收敛率。
AI.result: 当目标函数 $f$ 和约束函数 $c$ 都假定位于RKHS时，CEI算法对于常用的平方指数核和Matérn核（$ν>\frac{1}{2}$）分别达到了 $\mathcal{O} \left(t^{-\frac{1}{2}}\log^{\frac{d+1}{2}}(t) \right)$ 和 $\mathcal{O}\left(t^{\frac{-ν}{2ν+d}} \log^{\fracν{2ν+d}}(t)\right)$ 的收敛率。当 $f$ 被假定为从GP采样的时，CEI以高概率达到相似的收敛率。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过分析CEI算法的简单遗憾上界，在目标函数和约束函数位于RKHS或从GP采样的假设下，证明了CEI算法的收敛速度，并提供了具体的收敛率表达式。数值实验验证了理论分析的正确性。
AI.translation: 约束贝叶斯优化（CBO）方法在带约束的黑盒优化中取得了显著成功。最常用的CBO方法之一是约束期望改进（CEI）算法。CEI是约束的期望改进（EI）的自然扩展。然而，CEI的理论收敛率尚未建立。在这项工作中，我们通过分析其简单遗憾上界来研究CEI的收敛率。首先，我们证明了当假设目标函数 $f$ 和约束函数 $c$ 各自位于再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）时，CEI对于常用的平方指数核和Matérn核（$ν>\frac{1}{2}$）分别达到了 $\mathcal{O} \left(t^{-\frac{1}{2}}\log^{\frac{d+1}{2}}(t) \right)$ 和 $\mathcal{O}\left(t^{\frac{-ν}{2ν+d}} \log^{\fracν{2ν+d}}(t)\right)$ 的收敛率。其次，我们证明了当 $f$ 被假定为从高斯过程（GP）采样时，CEI以高概率达到相似的收敛率。进行了数值实验以验证理论分析。
AI.summary: 本文研究了约束期望改进（CEI）算法的理论收敛速度，该算法是常用的约束贝叶斯优化方法。作者通过分析CEI的简单遗憾上界，证明了在目标函数和约束函数位于再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）的假设下，CEI对于平方指数核和Matérn核具有特定的收敛率；同时，在函数来自高斯过程（GP）的假设下，也证明了其高概率收敛率。数值实验验证了这些理论结果。
AI.keywords: 约束贝叶斯优化, 约束期望改进, 收敛速度, 再生核希尔伯特空间, 高斯过程
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于首次从理论上建立了约束期望改进（CEI）算法的收敛速度界限，特别是针对常用的核函数（如平方指数核和Matérn核）给出了具体的收敛率，填补了该领域理论分析的空白。其重要性在于为CEI算法的理论可靠性提供了数学保证。局限性在于理论分析是基于目标函数和约束函数位于再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）或从高斯过程（GP）采样的假设。

title: A new measure of dependence: Integrated $R^2$
comments: added multidimensional covariate examples, concentration result, conditional dependence, corrected typos
summary: We introduce a novel measure of dependence that captures the extent to which a random variable $Y$ is determined by a random vector $X$. The measure equals zero precisely when $Y$ and $X$ are independent, and it attains one exactly when $Y$ is almost surely a measurable function of $X$. We further extend this framework to define a measure of conditional dependence between $Y$ and $X$ given $Z$. We propose a simple and interpretable estimator with computational complexity comparable to classical correlation coefficients, including those of Pearson, Spearman, and Chatterjee. Leveraging this dependence measure, we develop a tuning-free, model-agnostic variable selection procedure and establish its consistency under appropriate sparsity conditions. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real datasets highlight the strong empirical performance of our methodology and demonstrate substantial gains over existing approaches.

AI.title_translation: 一种新的依赖性度量：集成 $R^2$
AI.tldr: 研究人员发明了一个新的依赖性度量“集成 $R^2$”，它可以衡量一个变量对另一个变量的依赖程度（从 0 到 1），并能扩展到条件依赖性。他们还提供了一个易于计算的估计方法，并用它成功地开发了一个强大的、无需调优的变量选择工具，实验结果表明效果优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 捕获随机变量 $Y$ 被随机向量 $X$ 决定的程度，该度量在 $Y$ 和 $X$ 独立时为零，在 $Y$ 几乎可以肯定是 $X$ 的可测函数时为一。
AI.method: 引入了一种新的依赖性度量“集成 $R^2$”，该度量精确地量化了随机变量 $Y$ 被随机向量 $X$ 决定的程度。该框架被扩展到定义给定 $Z$ 时 $Y$ 和 $X$ 之间的条件依赖性度量。提出了一种简单且可解释的估计器，其计算复杂度与经典相关系数相当。利用此度量，开发了一种无调优、模型无关的变量选择程序，并在适当的稀疏性条件下证明了其一致性。
AI.result: 提出了一种新的依赖性度量及其条件依赖性扩展，并提出了一个计算复杂度与经典相关系数相当的简单可解释的估计器。基于此度量，开发了一种一致的、无调优、模型无关的变量选择程序。实验结果表明了该方法相对于现有方法的优越性能。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的集成 $R^2$ 依赖性度量在合成和真实数据集上的广泛实验表明，该方法具有强大的实证性能，并比现有方法取得了显著的改进。
AI.translation: 我们介绍了一种新颖的依赖性度量，它捕获了随机变量 $Y$ 在多大程度上由随机向量 $X$ 决定。该度量在 $Y$ 和 $X$ 独立时精确地等于零，在 $Y$ 几乎可以肯定是 $X$ 的可测函数时精确地达到一。我们进一步将此框架扩展为定义给定 $Z$ 时 $Y$ 和 $X$ 之间的条件依赖性度量。我们提出了一种简单且可解释的估计器，其计算复杂度与包括皮尔逊、斯皮尔曼和查特吉在内的经典相关系数相当。利用这种依赖性度量，我们开发了一种无调优、模型无关的变量选择程序，并在适当的稀疏性条件下确立了其一致性。在合成和真实数据集上的广泛实验突显了我们方法的强大实证性能，并证明了相对于现有方法的显著增益。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为“集成 $R^2$”的新颖依赖性度量，用于量化一个随机变量被另一个随机向量决定的程度，该度量在独立时为零，在完全依赖时为一。研究人员还定义了条件依赖性，并提出了一个易于解释且计算效率高的估计器。基于此度量，他们开发了一种模型无关的变量选择方法，并通过实证研究证明了其优越性。
AI.keywords: 集成 $R^2$, 依赖性度量, 变量选择, 条件依赖性, 估计器
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新的依赖性度量“集成 $R^2$”，其创新之处在于它能精确地量化一个随机变量被另一个随机向量决定的程度，并具有易于解释的估计器。其重要性在于它提供了一个比传统相关系数更全面的依赖性度量，并可用于模型无关的变量选择。抽象的局限性在于它没有详细说明“适当的稀疏性条件”的具体内容。

title: From Alignment to Advancement: Bootstrapping Audio-Language Alignment with Synthetic Data
comments: Published in IEEE Transactions on Audio, Speech, and Language Processing (TASLP). Project Website: https://kuan2jiu99.github.io/Balsa
summary: Audio-aware large language models (ALLMs) have recently made great strides in understanding and processing audio inputs. These models are typically adapted from text-based large language models (LLMs) through additional training on audio-related tasks. This adaptation process presents two major limitations. First, ALLMs often suffer from catastrophic forgetting, where crucial textual capabilities like instruction-following are lost after training on audio data. In some cases, models may even hallucinate sounds that are not present in the input audio, raising concerns about reliability. Second, achieving cross-modal alignment between audio and language typically relies on large collections of task-specific question-answer pairs for instruction tuning, making it resource-intensive. To address these issues, previous works have leveraged the backbone LLMs to synthesize general-purpose, caption-style alignment data. In this paper, we propose a data generation framework that produces contrastive-like training data, designed to enhance ALLMs' ability to differentiate between present and absent sounds. We further extend our approach to multi-audio scenarios, enabling the model to either explain differences between audio inputs or produce unified captions that describe all inputs, thereby enhancing audio-language alignment. We refer to the entire ALLM training framework as bootstrapping audio-language alignment via synthetic data generation from backbone LLMs (BALSa). Experimental results indicate that our method effectively mitigates audio hallucinations while reliably maintaining strong performance on audio understanding and reasoning benchmarks, as well as instruction-following skills. Moreover, incorporating multi-audio training further enhances the model's comprehension and reasoning capabilities. Overall, BALSa offers an efficient and scalable approach to developing ALLMs.
comment: Published in IEEE Transactions on Audio, Speech, and Language Processing (TASLP). Project Website: https://kuan2jiu99.github.io/Balsa

AI.title_translation: 从对齐到进步：利用合成数据引导音频-语言对齐的自举学习
AI.tldr: 为了解决ALLM训练中指令遵循能力丢失和对齐数据昂贵的问题，我们引入了BALSa框架，它使用LLM生成特殊的对比性合成数据来训练ALLM，使其能更好地分辨声音的有无，并在多音频任务中表现更佳，最终在不牺牲文本能力的情况下提升了音频理解能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的ALLM适应过程存在两大局限：1) 容易发生灾难性遗忘，导致指令遵循等文本能力丢失，并可能产生音频幻觉；2) 依赖大量资源密集型的任务特定问答对进行跨模态对齐训练。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为BALSa（Bootstrapping Audio-Language Alignment via Synthetic Data Generation from Backbone LLMs）的数据生成框架。该框架利用骨干LLM生成对比性训练数据，旨在增强ALLM区分输入音频中存在和不存在声音的能力。该方法进一步扩展到多音频场景，以支持差异解释或统一描述生成。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，BALSa方法有效地减轻了音频幻觉，同时可靠地保持了在音频理解和推理基准上的强大性能，以及指令遵循能力。此外，纳入多音频训练进一步增强了模型的理解和推理能力。
AI.conclusion: BALSa提供了一种高效且可扩展的方法来开发ALLMs，它通过合成对比性训练数据，有效地减轻了音频幻觉，同时可靠地保持了在音频理解、推理基准以及指令遵循技能上的强大性能。多音频训练进一步增强了模型的理解和推理能力。
AI.translation: 音频感知大型语言模型（ALLMs）在理解和处理音频输入方面最近取得了巨大进步。这些模型通常通过在与音频相关的任务上进行额外训练来从基于文本的大型语言模型（LLMs）中进行调整。这种适应过程带来了两个主要的局限性。首先，ALLMs经常遭受灾难性遗忘，即在音频数据上训练后，指令遵循等关键的文本能力会丢失。在某些情况下，模型甚至可能幻觉出输入音频中不存在的声音，引发了对可靠性的担忧。其次，实现音频和语言之间的跨模态对齐通常依赖于大量的任务特定问答对进行指令调优，这使得资源消耗巨大。为了解决这些问题，先前的工作利用骨干LLMs来合成通用的、描述性的对齐数据。在本文中，我们提出了一种数据生成框架，用于生成对比性训练数据，旨在增强ALLMs区分存在和不存在声音的能力。我们进一步将该方法扩展到多音频场景，使模型能够解释音频输入之间的差异或生成描述所有输入的统一描述，从而增强音频-语言对齐。我们将整个ALLM训练框架称为通过骨干LLM合成数据引导的音频-语言对齐（BALSa）。实验结果表明，我们的方法有效地减轻了音频幻觉，同时可靠地保持了在音频理解和推理基准以及指令遵循技能上的强大性能。此外，纳入多音频训练进一步增强了模型的理解和推理能力。总而言之，BALSa为开发ALLMs提供了一种高效且可扩展的方法。
AI.summary: 本文提出了BALSa框架，旨在解决ALLM在适应过程中遇到的灾难性遗忘和资源密集型对齐数据的挑战。BALSa通过利用骨干LLM生成对比性的合成数据来引导音频-语言对齐，特别强化了模型区分声音存在与否的能力，并扩展到多音频场景。实验证明，BALSa能有效减少音频幻觉，同时保持甚至增强模型的理解和推理能力。
AI.keywords: 音频语言模型, 灾难性遗忘, 跨模态对齐, 合成数据, 对比学习
AI.comments: 该研究的创新点在于提出了一种利用骨干LLM合成对比性训练数据（BALSa框架）来增强ALLM的跨模态对齐能力，特别是区分存在和不存在声音的能力。其重要性在于提供了一种高效、可扩展的方法来解决现有ALLM在灾难性遗忘和资源密集型对齐数据方面的两大核心挑战。一个潜在的局限是，合成数据的质量直接影响最终模型的性能。

title: Shape-Aware Topological Representation for Pipeline Hyperbola Detection in GPR Data
summary: Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR) is a widely used Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) technique for subsurface exploration, particularly in infrastructure inspection and maintenance. However, conventional interpretation methods are often limited by noise sensitivity and a lack of structural awareness. This study presents a novel framework that enhances the detection of underground utilities, especially pipelines, by integrating shape-aware topological features derived from B-scan GPR images using Topological Data Analysis (TDA), with the spatial detection capabilities of the YOLOv5 deep neural network (DNN). We propose a novel shape-aware topological representation that amplifies structural features in the input data, thereby improving the model's responsiveness to the geometrical features of buried objects. To address the scarcity of annotated real-world data, we employ a Sim2Real strategy that generates diverse and realistic synthetic datasets, effectively bridging the gap between simulated and real-world domains. Experimental results demonstrate significant improvements in mean Average Precision (mAP), validating the robustness and efficacy of our approach. This approach underscores the potential of TDA-enhanced learning in achieving reliable, real-time subsurface object detection, with broad applications in urban planning, safety inspection, and infrastructure management.

AI.title_translation: 用于GPR数据中管道双曲线检测的形状感知拓扑表示
AI.tldr: 研究人员将拓扑数据分析（TDA）的形状特征与YOLOv5深度学习网络结合，用于增强探地雷达（GPR）图像中地下管道的检测，并通过合成数据训练模型，取得了mAP的显著提升。
AI.motivation: 传统的GPR解释方法在基础设施检测中受限于噪声敏感性和缺乏结构感知能力，因此需要一种能增强对管道等地下结构检测的鲁棒框架。
AI.method: 提出了一种新颖的形状感知拓扑表示方法，该方法利用拓扑数据分析（TDA）从B扫描GPR图像中提取特征，并将其与YOLOv5深度神经网络的空间检测能力相结合。为解决数据稀缺问题，采用了Sim2Real策略生成合成数据集。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，与现有方法相比，平均精度均值（mAP）有了显著提高，验证了该方法的鲁棒性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法证明了TDA增强学习在实现可靠、实时的地下物体检测方面的潜力，在城市规划、安全检查和基础设施管理中具有广泛的应用前景。
AI.translation: 探地雷达（GPR）是一种广泛使用的无损检测（NDT）技术，用于地下勘探，特别是在基础设施检查和维护中。然而，传统的解释方法往往受限于噪声敏感性和缺乏结构感知能力。本研究提出了一个新颖的框架，通过利用拓扑数据分析（TDA）从B扫描GPR图像中获得的形状感知拓扑特征，与YOLOv5深度神经网络的空间检测能力相结合，增强了对地下设施，特别是管道的检测。我们提出了一种新颖的形状感知拓扑表示，它增强了输入数据中的结构特征，从而提高了模型对埋藏物体几何特征的响应能力。为解决真实世界带注释数据的稀缺问题，我们采用了Sim2Real策略，生成了多样化且逼真的合成数据集，有效地弥合了模拟域和真实世界域之间的差距。实验结果表明平均精度均值（mAP）有显著提高，验证了我们方法的鲁棒性和有效性。该方法凸显了TDA增强学习在实现可靠、实时地下物体检测方面的潜力，在城市规划、安全检查和基础设施管理中具有广泛的应用。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种新颖的框架，通过整合拓扑数据分析（TDA）提取的形状感知拓扑特征与YOLOv5深度学习模型，以增强探地雷达（GPR）数据中地下管道的检测。该方法引入了形状感知拓扑表示来突出结构特征，并利用Sim2Real策略生成逼真的合成数据克服数据稀缺问题，实验证明了其卓越的性能。
AI.keywords: 探地雷达, 拓扑数据分析, YOLOv5, 管道检测, 形状感知表示
AI.comments: 该研究的创新点在于将拓扑数据分析（TDA）中提取的形状感知拓扑特征与YOLOv5深度学习模型相结合，以增强对地下管道等目标的检测能力。其重要性在于解决了传统GPR解释方法对噪声敏感和缺乏结构感知的问题，并在实际应用中展示了显著的性能提升。局限性可能在于对Sim2Real策略生成合成数据质量的依赖。

title: Stable Minima of ReLU Neural Networks Suffer from the Curse of Dimensionality: The Neural Shattering Phenomenon
comments: Camera Ready Version. Accepted by Neurips 2025 (Spotlight)
summary: We study the implicit bias of flatness / low (loss) curvature and its effects on generalization in two-layer overparameterized ReLU networks with multivariate inputs -- a problem well motivated by the minima stability and edge-of-stability phenomena in gradient-descent training. Existing work either requires interpolation or focuses only on univariate inputs. This paper presents new and somewhat surprising theoretical results for multivariate inputs. On two natural settings (1) generalization gap for flat solutions, and (2) mean-squared error (MSE) in nonparametric function estimation by stable minima, we prove upper and lower bounds, which establish that while flatness does imply generalization, the resulting rates of convergence necessarily deteriorate exponentially as the input dimension grows. This gives an exponential separation between the flat solutions compared to low-norm solutions (i.e., weight decay), which are known not to suffer from the curse of dimensionality. In particular, our minimax lower bound construction, based on a novel packing argument with boundary-localized ReLU neurons, reveals how flat solutions can exploit a kind of "neural shattering" where neurons rarely activate, but with high weight magnitudes. This leads to poor performance in high dimensions. We corroborate these theoretical findings with extensive numerical simulations. To the best of our knowledge, our analysis provides the first systematic explanation for why flat minima may fail to generalize in high dimensions.
comment: Camera Ready Version. Accepted by Neurips 2025 (Spotlight)

AI.title_translation: ReLU神经网络的稳定最小值遭受维度灾难：神经破碎现象
AI.tldr: ReLU网络的平坦最小值在高维输入下，由于“神经破碎”效应（高权重/低激活），其泛化性能会随维度呈指数级恶化，远不如低范数解。
AI.motivation: 研究梯度下降训练中最小值的稳定性（minima stability）和稳定性边缘（edge-of-stability）现象，并探究平坦性/低损失曲率的隐式偏置对双层过参数化ReLU网络在多元输入下的泛化影响。
AI.method: 通过理论分析，分别在（1）平坦解的泛化差距和（2）稳定最小值在非参数函数估计中的均方误差（MSE）这两个自然设置下，推导了上界和下界。特别是，通过一种基于边界局部化ReLU神经元的创新打包论证（packing argument）来构建最小极大下界。
AI.result: 证明了平坦性确实意味着泛化，但收敛率随着输入维度的增加必然呈指数级恶化。这与已知不遭受维度灾难的低范数解（权重衰减）形成了指数级的分离。发现平坦解可能利用一种“神经破碎”现象，即神经元很少激活但具有很高的权重幅度，导致在高维下性能不佳。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次系统地解释了为什么平坦最小值在高维情况下可能无法很好地泛化。
AI.translation: 我们研究了曲率平坦性/低（损失）曲率的隐式偏差及其对具有多元输入的双层过参数化ReLU网络泛化的影响——这是一个受梯度下降训练中最小值稳定性和稳定性边缘现象充分激励的问题。现有工作要么需要插值，要么只关注单变量输入。本文针对多元输入提出了一些新的、有些令人惊讶的理论结果。在（1）平坦解的泛化差距和（2）稳定最小值在非参数函数估计中的均方误差（MSE）这两个自然设置下，我们证明了上界和下界，它们确立了虽然平坦性确实意味着泛化，但由此产生的收敛率必然随着输入维度的增加呈指数级恶化。这与已知不遭受维度灾难的低范数解（即权重衰减）相比，为平坦解提供了指数级的分离。特别是，我们基于一种新颖的、具有边界局部化ReLU神经元的打包论证（packing argument）所建立的最小极大下界，揭示了平坦解如何利用一种“神经破碎”现象，即神经元很少激活，但具有很高的权重幅度。这导致在高维下性能不佳。我们用大量的数值模拟证实了这些理论发现。据我们所知，我们的分析首次系统地解释了为什么平坦最小值可能在高维下失效。
AI.summary: 本文研究了在多元输入下，双层过参数化ReLU网络中损失曲率（平坦性）的隐式偏置对泛化的影响。研究表明，尽管平坦解有助于泛化，但其收敛率会随着输入维度的增加呈指数级下降，这与不受维度灾难影响的低范数解形成鲜明对比。研究通过引入“神经破碎”机制（高权重、低激活的神经元）来解释这种高维下的性能下降，并提供了理论和数值上的证据。
AI.keywords: 平坦最小值, 维度灾难, ReLU网络, 神经破碎, 泛化
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于首次针对多元输入下的ReLU网络，系统地揭示了平坦最小值（Flat Minima）泛化性能受维度灾难影响的机制，并提出了“神经破碎”（Neural Shattering）的概念。其重要性在于解释了在深度学习中，尽管平坦性被认为是好的隐式偏置，但在高维情况下可能失效的原因。局限性可能在于主要关注两层网络，且主要集中在损失曲率（平坦性）而非其他隐式偏置。

title: When Less Is More: Binary Feedback Can Outperform Ordinal Comparisons in Ranking Recovery
summary: Paired comparison data, where users evaluate items in pairs, play a central role in ranking and preference learning tasks. While ordinal comparison data intuitively offer richer information than binary comparisons, this paper challenges that conventional wisdom. We propose a general parametric framework for modeling ordinal paired comparisons without ties. The model adopts a generalized additive structure, featuring a link function that quantifies the preference difference between two items and a pattern function that governs the distribution over ordinal response levels. This framework encompasses classical binary comparison models as special cases, by treating binary responses as binarized versions of ordinal data. Within this framework, we show that binarizing ordinal data can significantly improve the accuracy of ranking recovery. Specifically, we prove that under the counting algorithm, the ranking error associated with binary comparisons exhibits a faster exponential convergence rate than that of ordinal data. Furthermore, we characterize a substantial performance gap between binary and ordinal data in terms of a signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) determined by the pattern function. We identify the pattern function that minimizes the SNR and maximizes the benefit of binarization. Extensive simulations and a real application on the MovieLens dataset further corroborate our theoretical findings.

AI.title_translation: 当少即是多：二元反馈在排序恢复中优于序数比较
AI.tldr: 即使序数比较看起来信息更丰富，但对于排序恢复任务，将其二值化（只保留胜负信息）实际上可以带来更快的收敛速度和更高的准确性，尤其是在特定模型和算法下。
AI.motivation: 挑战了“序数比较数据比二元比较数据提供更丰富信息的传统观点”，并探索在排序恢复任务中二元反馈是否可以优于序数比较。
AI.method: 提出了一个用于建模序数配对比较的通用参数框架，该框架具有广义加性结构，包含一个量化偏好差异的链接函数和一个控制序数响应水平分布的模式函数。该方法通过将二元响应视为序数数据的二值化版本，并分析了计数算法下的排序误差收敛率。
AI.result: 证明了在计数算法下，与二元比较相关的排序误差比序数数据具有更快的指数收敛率；并确定了最小化信噪比（SNR）并最大化二元化性能增益的模式函数。模拟和真实数据集（MovieLens）的应用证实了这些理论发现。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，在计数算法下，与二元比较相关的排序误差比序数数据具有更快的指数收敛率，并且通过识别最小化信噪比的模式函数，可以最大化二元化的性能提升。
AI.translation: 配对比较数据，即用户对物品进行两两评估，在排序和偏好学习任务中起着核心作用。虽然序数比较数据直观上比二元比较提供更丰富的信息，但本文挑战了这一传统观念。我们提出了一个用于对序数配对比较进行建模的通用参数框架，不考虑平局。该模型采用广义加性结构，其特征是一个量化两个物品之间偏好差异的链接函数，以及一个控制序数响应水平分布的模式函数。通过将二元响应视为序数数据的二值化版本，该框架将经典二元比较模型作为其特例。在此框架内，我们证明了将序数数据二值化可以显著提高排序恢复的准确性。具体来说，我们证明了在计数算法下，与二元比较相关的排序误差比序数数据具有更快的指数收敛率。此外，我们根据模式函数确定的信噪比（SNR），刻画了二元数据和序数数据之间存在的显著性能差距。我们确定了最小化SNR并最大化二元化收益的模式函数。广泛的模拟和在MovieLens数据集上的真实应用进一步证实了我们的理论发现。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个用于建模序数配对比较的通用参数框架，挑战了序数数据信息更丰富的传统观点。研究表明，通过将序数数据二值化，在排序恢复任务中可以显著提高准确性。理论上证明了二元比较的计数算法具有更快的误差收敛率，并通过识别特定的模式函数来最大化二元化的优势。
AI.keywords: 二元反馈, 序数比较, 排序恢复, 广义加性模型, 收敛率
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于挑战了“序数比较信息更丰富”的传统观点，并通过理论证明和实验表明，在特定条件下，二元反馈（如胜/负）在恢复排序方面的准确性可以超越序数比较。其重要性在于为数据采集和模型选择提供了新的视角。局限性可能在于其模型（广义加性结构）的适用范围和假设。

title: MMMOS: Multi-domain Multi-axis Audio Quality Assessment
comments: 4 pages including 1 page of reference. Accepted by ASRU Audio MOS 2025 Challenge
summary: Accurate audio quality estimation is essential for developing and evaluating audio generation, retrieval, and enhancement systems. Existing non-intrusive assessment models predict a single Mean Opinion Score (MOS) for speech, merging diverse perceptual factors and failing to generalize beyond speech. We propose MMMOS, a no-reference, multi-domain audio quality assessment system that estimates four orthogonal axes: Production Quality, Production Complexity, Content Enjoyment, and Content Usefulness across speech, music, and environmental sounds. MMMOS fuses frame-level embeddings from three pretrained encoders (WavLM, MuQ, and M2D) and evaluates three aggregation strategies with four loss functions. By ensembling the top eight models, MMMOS shows a 20-30% reduction in mean squared error and a 4-5% increase in Kendall's τ versus baseline, gains first place in six of eight Production Complexity metrics, and ranks among the top three on 17 of 32 challenge metrics.
comment: 4 pages including 1 page of reference. Accepted by ASRU Audio MOS 2025 Challenge

AI.title_translation: MMMOS：多领域多轴音频质量评估
AI.tldr: MMMOS是一个创新的音频质量评估系统，它不再只给一个MOS分数，而是针对语音、音乐和环境音，同时评估生产质量、复杂度、内容享受和有用性四个维度，通过集成优化模型，在多个指标上大幅超越了现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的非侵入式音频质量评估模型通常只预测单一的平均意见得分（MOS），这会合并各种感知因素，并且难以泛化到语音以外的领域。因此，需要一个能够更精细地评估音频质量、并能跨领域应用的系统。
AI.method: MMMOS系统融合了来自三个预训练编码器（WavLM、MuQ和M2D）的帧级嵌入，并评估了四种损失函数下的三种聚合策略。最终通过集成（ensembling）性能最好的八个模型进行最终评估。
AI.result: 与基线模型相比，MMMOS将均方误差（MSE）降低了20-30%，肯德尔等级相关系数（Kendall's $\tau$）提高了4-5%。此外，它在六个生产复杂度指标中获得了第一名，并在32个挑战赛指标中名列前三。
AI.conclusion: 通过集成最佳模型，MMMOS在多个评估指标上显著优于基线模型，在生产复杂度指标上取得了领先地位，并在多个挑战赛指标中名列前茅，证明了其在多领域多轴音频质量评估方面的有效性。
AI.translation: 准确的音频质量估计对于开发和评估音频生成、检索和增强系统至关重要。现有的非侵入式评估模型预测语音的单一平均意见得分（MOS），合并了各种感知因素，并且无法泛化到语音以外的领域。我们提出了MMMOS，一个无参考、多领域的音频质量评估系统，它可以估计跨越语音、音乐和环境声音的四个正交轴：生产质量、生产复杂度、内容享受和内容有用性。MMMOS融合了来自三个预训练编码器（WavLM、MuQ和M2D）的帧级嵌入，并评估了四种损失函数下的三种聚合策略。通过集成性能最佳的八个模型，MMMOS在均方误差上比基线模型降低了20-30%，肯德尔等级相关系数（$\tau$）提高了4-5%，在六个生产复杂度指标中排名第一，并在32个挑战赛指标中名列前三。
AI.summary: MMMOS是一个新提出的无参考、多领域音频质量评估系统，旨在超越传统单一MOS预测的局限性。它能够同时估计语音、音乐和环境声音在生产质量、生产复杂度、内容享受和内容有用性这四个正交轴上的质量。通过融合多个预训练编码器的特征并集成最优模型，MMMOS在性能上显著优于现有基线。
AI.keywords: 音频质量评估, 多领域, 多轴, MMMOS, 非参考评估
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了一个能够同时评估多领域（语音、音乐、环境声）和多维度（生产质量、生产复杂度、内容享受、内容有用性）的音频质量评估系统MMMOS，克服了现有模型仅预测单一MOS且泛化能力差的局限性。其重要性在于为更精细的音频系统评估提供了新的工具。限制在于其性能提升是基于集成（ensembling）的，具体到单个模型的泛化能力仍需进一步研究。

title: Covering Complete Geometric Graphs by Monotone Paths
comments: Extended set of authors and strengthened results. 9 pages, 3 figures
summary: Given a set $A$ of $n$ points (vertices) in general position in the plane, the \emph{complete geometric graph} $K_n[A]$ consists of all $\binom{n}{2}$ segments (edges) between the elements of $A$. It is known that the edge set of every complete geometric graph on $n$ vertices can be partitioned into $O(n^{3/2})$ crossing-free paths (or matchings). We strengthen this result under various additional assumptions on the point set. In particular, we prove that for a set $A$ of $n$ \emph{randomly} selected points, uniformly distributed in $[0,1]^2$, with probability tending to $1$ as $n\rightarrow\infty$, the edge set of $K_n[A]$ can be covered by $O(n\log n)$ crossing-free paths and by $O(n\sqrt{\log n})$ crossing-free matchings. On the other hand, we construct $n$-element point sets such that covering the edge set of $K_n[A]$ requires a quadratic number of monotone paths.
comment: Extended set of authors and strengthened results. 9 pages, 3 figures

AI.title_translation: 覆盖完全几何图的单调路径
AI.tldr: 随机点集的完全几何图的边集可以用 $O(n\log n)$ 条非交叉路径或 $O(n\sqrt{\log n})$ 个非交叉匹配覆盖，但存在需要二次路径覆盖的特例。
AI.motivation: 已知完全几何图的边集可以被 $O(n^{3/2})$ 条非交叉路径划分，本文的动机是在特定假设（特别是随机点集）下加强这一结果。
AI.method: 通过对均匀随机选择的点集进行概率分析，推导出上界。同时，通过构造特定的点集来证明下界（需要二次路径）。
AI.result: 对于随机点集，边集可以被 $O(n\log n)$ 条非交叉路径覆盖，或被 $O(n\sqrt{\log n})$ 个非交叉匹配覆盖（概率趋于1）。存在需要二次单调路径覆盖的点集。
AI.conclusion: 对于随机点集，边集可以用 $O(n\log n)$ 条非交叉路径或 $O(n\sqrt{\log n})$ 个非交叉匹配覆盖；然而，存在需要二次单调路径覆盖的点集。
AI.translation: 给定平面上 $n$ 个点（顶点）的一般位置集合 $A$，完全几何图 $K_n[A]$ 由元素之间的所有 $\binom{n}{2}$ 条线段（边）组成。已知每个 $n$ 个顶点的完全几何图的边集可以被划分为 $O(n^{3/2})$ 条不交叉路径（或匹配）。我们在各种附加假设下加强了这一结果。特别是，我们证明对于 $n$ 个**随机**选择的点集，均匀分布在 $[0,1]^2$ 中，当 $n\rightarrow\infty$ 时，概率趋于 $1$， $K_n[A]$ 的边集可以用 $O(n\log n)$ 条不交叉路径和 $O(n\sqrt{\log n})$ 个不交叉匹配来覆盖。另一方面，我们构造了 $n$ 个点的点集，使得覆盖 $K_n[A]$ 的边集需要二次数量的单调路径。
AI.summary: 本文研究了用非交叉路径和匹配覆盖完全几何图 $K_n[A]$ 的边集的问题。对于均匀随机选择的点集，证明了其边集可以被 $O(n\log n)$ 条非交叉路径或 $O(n\sqrt{\log n})$ 个非交叉匹配覆盖。然而，也构造了需要二次单调路径覆盖的反例点集。
AI.keywords: 完全几何图, 非交叉路径, 匹配, 随机点集, 边覆盖
AI.comments: 该研究在随机点集上改进了覆盖完全几何图边集所需的非交叉路径和匹配的数量，但指出了在某些特定点集上仍需要二次路径的数量，突出了随机性和特定结构之间的对比。创新点在于对随机点集给出了更紧的上界。

title: HuiduRep: A Robust Self-Supervised Framework for Learning Neural Representations from Extracellular Recordings
summary: Extracellular recordings are transient voltage fluctuations in the vicinity of neurons, serving as a fundamental modality in neuroscience for decoding brain activity at single-neuron resolution. Spike sorting, the process of attributing each detected spike to its corresponding neuron, is a pivotal step in brain sensing pipelines. However, it remains challenging under low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), electrode drift and cross-session variability. In this paper, we propose HuiduRep, a robust self-supervised representation learning framework that extracts discriminative and generalizable features from extracellular recordings. By integrating contrastive learning with a denoising autoencoder, HuiduRep learns latent representations that are robust to noise and drift. With HuiduRep, we develop a spike sorting pipeline that clusters spike representations without ground truth labels. Experiments on hybrid and real-world datasets demonstrate that HuiduRep achieves strong robustness. Furthermore, the pipeline outperforms state-of-the-art tools such as KiloSort4 and MountainSort5. These findings demonstrate the potential of self-supervised spike representation learning as a foundational tool for robust and generalizable processing of extracellular recordings. Code is available at: https://github.com/IgarashiAkatuki/HuiduRep

AI.title_translation: HuiduRep：一个用于从细胞外记录中学习神经表征的鲁棒自监督框架
AI.tldr: HuiduRep是一个创新的自监督学习框架，它使用对比学习和去噪自编码器从细胞外记录中学习鲁棒的神经元特征，从而实现无需标签的、优于现有方法的神经元放电分类。
AI.motivation: 细胞外记录是神经科学解码脑活动的基础方式，但其关键步骤——神经元放电分类——在低信噪比（SNR）、电极漂移和跨会话变异性下仍然具有挑战性。
AI.method: HuiduRep框架，通过整合对比学习和一个去噪自编码器来学习对噪声和漂移具有鲁棒性的潜在表示。利用这些表示来构建一个无需地面真值标签即可对放电进行聚类的神经元放电分类流水线。
AI.result: HuiduRep 实现了强大的鲁棒性，并且其神经元放电分类流水线在混合和真实世界数据集上的表现优于 KiloSort4 和 MountainSort5 等最先进的工具。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，自监督的神经元放电表示学习是用于稳健和可泛化处理细胞外记录的基础工具的潜力。
AI.translation: 细胞外记录是神经元附近的瞬态电压波动，是神经科学中用于以单神经元分辨率解码脑活动的基本模式。神经元放电分类，即将每个检测到的尖峰归因于其相应的神经元的过程，是脑传感管道中的关键步骤。然而，在低信噪比（SNR）、电极漂移和跨会话变异性下，它仍然具有挑战性。在本文中，我们提出了 HuiduRep，一个鲁棒的自监督表示学习框架，用于从细胞外记录中提取判别性和可泛化的特征。通过将对比学习与去噪自编码器相结合，HuiduRep 学习到的潜在表示对噪声和漂移具有鲁棒性。利用 HuiduRep，我们开发了一种神经元放电分类流水线，该流水线在没有地面真值标签的情况下对尖峰表示进行聚类。在混合和真实世界数据集上的实验证明 HuiduRep 具有强大的鲁棒性。此外，该流水线优于 KiloSort4 和 MountainSort5 等最先进的工具。这些发现证明了自监督神经元放电表示学习作为稳健和可泛化处理细胞外记录的基础工具的潜力。代码可在：https://github.com/IgarashiAkatuki/HuiduRep 获取。
AI.summary: HuiduRep是一个新颖的自监督表示学习框架，用于从细胞外记录中提取对噪声和漂移具有鲁棒性的判别性特征。该框架通过结合对比学习和去噪自编码器实现，并用于开发一个无需标签的神经元放电分类流水线，实验证明其在复杂条件下的稳健性和优越性能。
AI.keywords: 细胞外记录, 自监督学习, 对比学习, 去噪自编码器, 神经元放电分类
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一个结合对比学习和去噪自编码器的自监督框架 (HuiduRep)，用于从细胞外记录中学习鲁棒的神经表征，解决了低信噪比、电极漂移和跨会话变异性带来的挑战。其重要性在于提供了一种无需地面真值标签即可进行神经元集群划分的稳健方法。限制是仅基于提供的标题和摘要进行分析。

title: Bag of Coins: A Statistical Probe into Neural Confidence Structures
summary: Modern neural networks often produce miscalibrated confidence scores and struggle to detect out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs, while most existing methods post-process outputs without testing internal consistency. We introduce the Bag-of-Coins (BoC) probe, a non-parametric diagnostic of logit coherence that compares softmax confidence $\hat p$ to an aggregate of pairwise Luce-style dominance probabilities $\bar q$, yielding a deterministic coherence score and a p-value-based structural score. Across ViT, ResNet, and RoBERTa with ID/OOD test sets, the coherence gap $Δ=\bar q-\hat p$ reveals clear ID/OOD separation for ViT (ID ${\sim}0.1$-$0.2$, OOD ${\sim}0.5$-$0.6$) but substantial overlap for ResNet and RoBERTa (both ${\sim}0$), indicating architecture-dependent uncertainty geometry. As a practical method, BoC improves calibration only when the base model is poorly calibrated (ViT: ECE $0.024$ vs.\ $0.180$) and underperforms standard calibrators (ECE ${\sim}0.005$), while for OOD detection it fails across architectures (AUROC $0.020$-$0.253$) compared to standard scores ($0.75$-$0.99$). We position BoC as a research diagnostic for interrogating how architectures encode uncertainty in logit geometry rather than a production calibration or OOD detection method.

AI.title_translation: 硬币袋：对神经网络置信度结构的统计探测
AI.tldr: Bag-of-Coins (BoC) 是一种新的非参数探测方法，用于评估神经网络内部的置信度一致性，通过比较 softmax 置信度与成对 Luce 风格的优势概率。它在区分同一分布内（ID）和分布外（OOD）输入方面，对 Vision Transformer (ViT) 表现出良好的分离能力，但对 ResNet 和 RoBERTa 的区分能力较弱，表明了模型架构对不确定性几何形状的影响。虽然 BoC 在改善模型校准方面仅在基础模型校准不佳时有效，并且在 OOD 检测方面表现不佳，但它被定位为一种用于研究模型如何编码不确定性的诊断工具，而非实际的校准或 OOD 检测方法。
AI.motivation: 现代神经网络常常产生校准不佳的置信度分数，并且难以检测分布外（OOD）输入，而现有方法大多在事后处理输出，并未检验内部一致性。
AI.method:
Bag-of-Coins (BoC) 探测器，一种非参数的 logit 一致性诊断方法，它比较 softmax 置信度 $\hat p$ 与成对 Luce 风格优势概率的聚合 $\bar q$，从而产生确定性的 
一致性分数和基于 p 值的结构分数。
AI.result: 在 Vision Transformer (ViT)、ResNet 和 RoBERTa 模型上，使用 ID/OOD 测试集进行测试，发现一致性差距 $Δ=\bar q-\hat p$ 能够清晰地区分 ID/OOD 输入（ViT：ID $\sim 0.1$-$0.2$，OOD $\sim 0.5$-$0.6$），但在 ResNet 和 RoBERTa 上（两者 $\sim 0$）则存在显著重叠，表明了架构依赖性的不确定性几何形状。作为一种实际方法，BoC 仅在基础模型校准不佳时能改善校准（ViT：ECE $0.024$ vs. $0.180$），并且表现不如标准校准器（ECE $\sim 0.005$）。在 OOD 检测方面，BoC 在所有架构上均表现不佳（AUROC $0.020$-$0.253$），而标准分数表现优异（$0.75$-$0.99$）。
AI.conclusion: BoC 被定位为一种用于探究模型架构如何通过 logit 几何形状来编码不确定性的研究诊断工具，而不是一种用于实际生产环境的校准或 OOD 检测方法。
AI.translation:
现代神经网络常常产生校准不佳的置信度分数，并且难以检测分布外（OOD）输入，而现有方法大多在事后处理输出，并未检验内部一致性。我们引入了 Bag-of-Coins (BoC) 探测器，一种非参数的 logit 一致性诊断方法，它比较 softmax 置信度 $\hat p$ 与成对 Luce 风格优势概率的聚合 $\bar q$，从而产生确定的 
一致性分数和基于 p 值的结构分数。在 ViT、ResNet 和 RoBERTa 模型上，使用 ID/OOD 测试集进行测试，发现一致性差距 $Δ=\bar q-\hat p$ 能够清晰地区分 ID/OOD 输入（ViT：ID $\sim 0.1$-$0.2$，OOD $\sim 0.5$-$0.6$），但在 ResNet 和 RoBERTa 上（两者 $\sim 0$）则存在显著重叠，表明了架构依赖性的不确定性几何形状。作为一种实际方法，BoC 仅在基础模型校准不佳时能改善校准（ViT：ECE $0.024$ vs. $0.180$），并且表现不如标准校准器（ECE $\sim 0.005$）。在 OOD 检测方面，BoC 在所有架构上均表现不佳（AUROC $0.020$-$0.253$），而标准分数表现优异（$0.75$-$0.99$）。我们提出 BoC 作为一种研究诊断工具，用于探究模型架构如何通过 logit 几何形状来编码不确定性，而不是一种生产环境下的校准或 OOD 检测方法。
AI.summary: Bag-of-Coins (BoC) 是一种新的非参数探测方法，用于评估神经网络内部的置信度一致性。它通过比较 softmax 置信度与成对 Luce 风格的优势概率来衡量 logit 的一致性。研究表明，BoC 在区分同一分布内（ID）和分布外（OOD）输入方面，对 Vision Transformer (ViT) 表现出良好的分离能力，但对 ResNet 和 RoBERTa 的区分能力较弱，这揭示了不同神经网络架构在不确定性表示上的差异。虽然 BoC 在改善模型校准方面仅在基础模型校准不佳时有效，并且在 OOD 检测方面表现不佳，但它被定位为一种用于研究模型如何编码不确定性的诊断工具，而非实际的校准或 OOD 检测方法。
AI.keywords: Bag-of-Coins, 神经网络置信度, logit 一致性, 不确定性几何, 架构依赖性
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种名为 Bag-of-Coins (BoC) 的新颖探测方法，用于分析神经网络内部的置信度结构。BoC 的主要贡献在于其非参数的性质以及能够通过比较 softmax 置信度和聚合的 Luce 风格优势概率来评估 logit 的一致性。研究结果揭示了不同神经网络架构（如 ViT、ResNet、RoBERTa）在不确定性几何形状表示上的显著差异，为理解模型行为提供了新的视角。然而，该方法在实际应用中，如模型校准和 OOD 检测方面，表现不如现有标准方法，这限制了其直接的工程应用价值。尽管如此，BoC 作为一种研究诊断工具，在探究神经网络如何编码不确定性方面具有重要意义，为未来的理论研究开辟了道路。

title: From Sublinear to Linear: Fast Convergence in Deep Networks via Locally Polyak-Lojasiewicz Regions
summary: Gradient descent (GD) on deep neural network loss landscapes is non-convex, yet often converges far faster in practice than classical guarantees suggest. Prior work shows that within locally quasi-convex regions (LQCRs), GD converges to stationary points at sublinear rates, leaving the commonly observed near-exponential training dynamics unexplained. We show that, under a mild local Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) stability assumption, the loss satisfies a PL-type error bound within these regions, yielding a Locally Polyak-Lojasiewicz Region (LPLR) in which the squared gradient norm controls the suboptimality gap. For properly initialized finite-width networks, we show that under local NTK stability this PL-type mechanism holds around initialization and establish linear convergence of GD as long as the iterates remain within the resulting LPLR. Empirically, we observe PL-like scaling and linear-rate loss decay in controlled full-batch training and in a ResNet-style CNN trained with mini-batch SGD on a CIFAR-10 subset, indicating that LPLR signatures can persist under modern architectures and stochastic optimization. Overall, the results connect local geometric structure, local NTK stability, and fast optimization rates in a finite-width setting.

AI.title_translation: 从亚线性到线性：通过局部 Polyak-Lojasiewicz 区域在深度网络中实现快速收敛
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种新的理论框架，解释了深度网络中梯度下降为何能快速收敛。研究发现，在特定条件下，损失函数满足局部 Polyak-Lojasiewicz (PL) 条件，从而在局部区域内实现线性收敛，这比之前已知的亚线性收敛理论更能解释实践中的快速训练动态。
AI.motivation: 现有的梯度下降（GD）在深度神经网络（DNN）损失景观上的收敛理论表明其收敛速度为亚线性，这与实践中观察到的近指数级训练动态不符。该研究旨在弥合这一理论与实践之间的差距，解释为何 GD 在 DNN 中能如此快速地收敛。
AI.method: 该研究通过引入“局部 Polyak-Lojasiewicz 区域”（LPLR）的概念来分析 GD 的收敛性。在局部神经切线核（NTK）稳定性假设下，研究人员证明了损失函数在 LPLR 内满足类似 PL 的误差界限，即平方梯度范数可以控制次优差距。对于初始化状态下的有限宽度网络，他们证明了只要迭代过程保持在 LPLR 内，GD 就能实现线性收敛。
AI.result: 研究表明，在局部 NTK 稳定性假设下，深度网络的损失函数在其局部区域内满足 PL 型误差界限，形成局部 Polyak-Lojasiewicz 区域（LPLR）。在此区域内，平方梯度范数可控制次优差距。对于初始化状态下的有限宽度网络，只要迭代过程保持在 LPLR 内，GD 即可实现线性收敛。实验结果在全批量训练和带有小批量 SGD 的 ResNet 类 CNN 上得到了验证，表明 LPLR 的特征在现代网络结构和随机优化下仍然存在。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功地将局部几何结构、局部 NTK 稳定性和有限宽度设置下的快速优化率联系起来。通过引入 LPLR 的概念，该研究为理解深度网络中 GD 的快速收敛现象提供了一个新的理论视角，并解释了为何实践中的训练速度往往优于传统的亚线性收敛保证。
AI.translation: 梯度下降（GD）在深度神经网络损失景观上的优化是非凸的，但实际上往往比经典保证收敛得快得多。先前的工作表明，在局部类凸区域（LQCRs）内，GD 以亚线性速率收敛到平稳点，这使得人们普遍观察到的接近指数级的训练动态难以解释。我们表明，在温和的局部神经切线核（NTK）稳定性假设下，损失函数在这些区域内满足类似 PL 的误差界限，从而产生一个局部 Polyak-Lojasiewicz 区域（LPLR），在该区域内平方梯度范数控制着次优差距。对于正确初始化的有限宽度网络，我们表明在局部 NTK 稳定性下，这种类似 PL 的机制在初始化附近成立，并证明只要迭代保持在由此产生的 LPLR 内，GD 就能实现线性收敛。在实践中，我们观察到在受控的全批量训练以及在 CIFAR-10 子集上用小批量 SGD 训练的 ResNet 类 CNN 中，存在类似 PL 的缩放和线性速率的损失衰减，这表明 LPLR 的特征可以在现代架构和随机优化下持续存在。总的来说，这些结果在有限宽度设置中将局部几何结构、局部 NTK 稳定性和快速优化率联系起来。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了“局部 Polyak-Lojasiewicz 区域”（LPLR）的概念，以解释深度神经网络中梯度下降（GD）为何能实现比理论预测更快的收敛速度。研究证明，在局部神经切线核（NTK）稳定性假设下，GD 在 LPLR 内可以实现线性收敛，这比先前已知的亚线性收敛理论更能反映实践中的快速训练动态。实验结果也支持了该理论在现代网络和随机优化中的有效性。
AI.keywords: 局部 Polyak-Lojasiewicz 区域, 梯度下降, 深度神经网络, 线性收敛, 神经切线核稳定性
AI.comments: 这项研究在理论上取得了重要进展，成功地将深度学习中的快速收敛现象与局部几何性质（LPLR）和 NTK 稳定性联系起来，为理解非凸优化提供了一个新的视角。然而，该研究的理论分析主要集中在有限宽度网络和局部区域，未来可以进一步探索这些结果在无限宽度极限或全局优化特性方面的推广。同时，尽管实验结果支持了理论，但实际应用中的随机性和复杂性可能仍然会影响 LPLR 的持续性，这方面的鲁棒性分析也值得关注。

title: Simulating Posterior Bayesian Neural Networks with Dependent Weights
summary: We consider fully connected and feedforward deep neural networks with dependent and possibly heavy-tailed weights, as introduced in Lee et al. 2023, to address limitations of the standard Gaussian prior. It has been proved in Lee et al. 2023 that, as the number of nodes in the hidden layers grows large, according to a sequential and ordered limit, the law of the output converges weakly to a Gaussian mixture. Among our results, we present sufficient conditions on the model parameters (the activation function and the associated Lévy measures) which ensure that the sequential limit is independent of the order. Next, we study the neural network through the lens of the posterior distribution with a Gaussian likelihood. If the random covariance matrix of the infinite-width limit is positive definite under the prior, we identify the posterior distribution of the output in the wide-width limit according to a sequential regime. Remarkably, we provide mild sufficient conditions to ensure the aforementioned invertibility of the random covariance matrix under the prior, thereby extending the results in L. Carvalho et al. 2025. We illustrate our findings using numerical simulations.

AI.title_translation: 贝叶斯神经网络带依赖权重模拟
AI.tldr: 该研究考虑了具有依赖性（可能为重尾）权重的全连接前馈深度神经网络，并证明了在隐藏层节点数量趋于无穷时，输出的律依概率收敛于高斯混合模型。研究提出了保证顺序极限与顺序无关的模型参数（激活函数和 Lévy 测度）的充分条件。此外，在具有高斯似然的后验分布的视角下，研究识别了输出在宽宽度极限下的后验分布，并给出了随机协方差矩阵可逆性的温和充分条件，扩展了先前的工作。
AI.motivation: 标准高斯先验存在局限性，需要考虑具有依赖性（可能为重尾）权重的神经网络。
AI.method: 考虑全连接和前馈深度神经网络，并分析其在隐藏层节点数量趋于无穷时的输出律的收敛性。通过高斯似然的后验分布视角，研究了输出在宽宽度极限下的后验分布。
AI.result: 在隐藏层节点数量趋于无穷时，输出的律依概率收敛于高斯混合模型。提出了保证顺序极限与顺序无关的模型参数（激活函数和 Lévy 测度）的充分条件。在随机协方差矩阵在先验下为正定时，识别了输出在宽宽度极限下的后验分布。给出了随机协方差矩阵可逆性的温和充分条件。
AI.conclusion: 该研究扩展了对具有依赖性权重的深度神经网络的理解，特别是在无限宽度极限下，并为理论分析提供了新的见解和工具。
AI.translation: 我们考虑了 Lee 等人 2023 年引入的具有依赖性且可能为重尾权重的全连接前馈深度神经网络，以解决标准高斯先验的局限性。Lee 等人 2023 年已证明，随着隐藏层节点数量的增加，根据顺序和有序极限，输出的律依概率收敛于高斯混合模型。在我们的结果中，我们提出了模型参数（激活函数和相关的 Lévy 测度）的充分条件，以确保顺序极限与顺序无关。接下来，我们通过具有高斯似然的后验分布的视角来研究神经网络。如果无限宽度极限的随机协方差矩阵在先验下是正定的，我们根据顺序机制识别了宽宽度极限下输出的后验分布。值得注意的是，我们提供了温和的充分条件来确保先验下随机协方差矩阵的可逆性，从而扩展了 L. Carvalho 等人 2025 年的结果。我们用数值模拟来说明我们的发现。
AI.summary: 本研究考虑了具有依赖性（可能为重尾）权重的全连接前馈深度神经网络，并证明了在隐藏层节点数量趋于无穷时，输出的律依概率收敛于高斯混合模型。研究提出了保证顺序极限与顺序无关的模型参数（激活函数和 Lévy 测度）的充分条件。此外，在具有高斯似然的后验分布的视角下，研究识别了输出在宽宽度极限下的后验分布，并给出了随机协方差矩阵可逆性的温和充分条件，扩展了先前的工作。研究结果通过数值模拟进行了说明。
AI.keywords: 贝叶斯神经网络, 依赖权重, 无限宽度极限, 高斯混合模型, 后验分布
AI.comments: 该研究在理论上深入探讨了深度神经网络在无限宽度极限下的行为，特别是引入了具有依赖性权重的模型，这比标准的高斯先验模型更具一般性。研究结果对于理解和构建更复杂的神经网络模型具有重要意义。然而，数值模拟的细节和具体模型的选择可能会影响结果的普适性。

title: TensorHyper-VQC: A Tensor-Train-Guided Hypernetwork for Robust and Scalable Variational Quantum Computing
comments: The paper has been accepted by npj Quantum Information
summary: Variational Quantum Computing (VQC) faces fundamental scalability barriers, primarily due to barren plateaus and sensitivity to quantum noise. To address these challenges, we introduce TensorHyper-VQC, a novel tensor-train (TT)-guided hypernetwork framework that significantly improves the robustness and scalability of VQC. Our framework fully delegates the generation of quantum circuit parameters to a classical TT network, effectively decoupling optimization from quantum hardware. This innovative parameterization mitigates gradient vanishing, enhances noise resilience through structured low-rank representations, and facilitates efficient gradient propagation. Grounded in Neural Tangent Kernel and statistical learning theory, our rigorous theoretical analyses establish strong guarantees on approximation capability, optimization stability, and generalization performance. Extensive empirical results across quantum dot classification, Max-Cut optimization, and molecular quantum simulation tasks demonstrate that TensorHyper-VQC consistently achieves superior performance and robust noise tolerance, including hardware-level validation on a 156-qubit IBM Heron processor. These results position TensorHyper-VQC as a scalable and noise-resilient framework for advancing practical quantum machine learning on near-term devices.
comment: The paper has been accepted by npj Quantum Information

title: Time-complexity of sampling from a multimodal distribution using sequential Monte Carlo
summary: We study a sequential Monte Carlo algorithm to sample from the Gibbs measure with a non-convex energy function at a low temperature. We use the practical and popular geometric annealing schedule, and use a Langevin diffusion at each temperature level. The Langevin diffusion only needs to run for a time that is long enough to ensure local mixing within energy valleys, which is much shorter than the time required for global mixing. Our main result shows convergence of Monte Carlo estimators with time complexity that, approximately, scales like the fourth power of the inverse temperature, and the square of the inverse allowed error. We also study this algorithm in an illustrative model scenario where more explicit estimates can be given.

title: Scalable hybrid quantum Monte Carlo simulation of U(1) gauge field coupled to fermions on GPU
summary: We develop a GPU-accelerated hybrid quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) algorithm to solve the fundamental yet difficult problem of $U(1)$ gauge field coupled to fermions, which gives rise to a $U(1)$ Dirac spin liquid state under the description of (2+1)d quantum electrodynamics QED$_3$. The algorithm renders a good acceptance rate and, more importantly, nearly linear space-time volume scaling in computational complexity $O(N_τ V_s)$, where $N_τ$ is the imaginary time dimension and $V_s$ is spatial volume, which is much more efficient than determinant QMC with scaling behavior of $O(N_τV_s^3)$. Such acceleration is achieved via a collection of technical improvements, including (i) the design of the efficient problem-specific preconditioner, (ii) customized CUDA kernel for matrix-vector multiplication, and (iii) CUDA Graph implementation on the GPU. These advances allow us to simulate the $U(1)$ Dirac spin liquid state with unprecedentedly large system sizes, which is up to $N_τ\times L\times L = 660\times66\times66$, and reveal its novel properties. With these technical improvements, we see the asymptotic convergence in the scaling dimensions of various fermion bilinear operators and the conserved current operator when approaching the thermodynamic limit. The scaling dimensions find good agreement with field-theoretical expectation, which provides supporting evidence for the conformal nature of the $U(1)$ Dirac spin liquid state in the QED$_3$. Our technical advancements open an avenue to study the Dirac spin liquid state and its transition towards symmetry-breaking phases at larger system sizes and with less computational burden.

title: Quantum Paths: a Quantum Walk approach
comments: Accepted manuscript for publication in Proceedings of IEEE International Conference on Quantum Computing and Engineering 2025. This work has been funded by the European Union under Horizon Europe ERC-CoG grant QNattyNet ("Quantum-Native Communication Networks: from Quantum Message to Quantum Functioning"), n.101169850. Details at https://qnattynet.quantuminternet.it
summary: The quantum switch, a process enabling a coherent superposition of different orders of quantum channels, has garnered significant attention due to its ability to enable noiseless communications through noisy channels, such as entanglement-breaking channels. However, its practical implementation and scalability remain challenging. In contrast, the spatial superposition of quantum channels is more accessible experimentally and has been shown to enhance channel capacity, although it does not match the performance of the quantum switch. In this work, we present preliminary theoretical results demonstrating that, by applying tools of the quantum random walk framework to the spatial superposition of channels, it is possible to replicate the output of a quantum switch. These findings suggest a promising and more feasible route to emulate the quantum switch, offering both practical advantages and interpretative clarity.

title: Accelerated Interactive Auralization of Highly Reverberant Spaces using Graphics Hardware
comments: 9 pages, 6 figures, submitted to Journal of the Audio Engineering Society
summary: Interactive acoustic auralization allows users to explore virtual acoustic environments in real-time, enabling the acoustic recreation of concert hall or Historical Worship Spaces (HWS) that are either no longer accessible, acoustically altered, or impractical to visit. Interactive acoustic synthesis requires real-time convolution of input signals with a set of synthesis filters that model the space-time acoustic response of the space. The acoustics in concert halls and HWS are both characterized by a long reverberation time, resulting in synthesis filters containing many filter taps. As a result, the convolution process can be computationally demanding, introducing significant latency that limits the real-time interactivity of the auralization system. In this paper, the implementation of a real-time multichannel loudspeaker-based auralization system is presented. This system is capable of synthesizing the acoustics of highly reverberant spaces in real-time using GPU-acceleration. A comparison between traditional CPU-based convolution and GPU-accelerated convolution is presented, showing that the latter can achieve real-time performance with significantly lower latency. Additionally, the system integrates acoustic synthesis with acoustic feedback cancellation on the GPU, creating a unified loudspeaker-based auralization framework that minimizes processing latency.
comment: 9 pages, 6 figures, submitted to Journal of the Audio Engineering Society

title: A Kernel-based Stochastic Approximation Framework for Nonlinear Operator Learning
summary: We develop a stochastic approximation framework for learning nonlinear operators between infinite-dimensional spaces utilizing general Mercer operator-valued kernels. Our framework encompasses two key classes: (i) compact kernels, which admit discrete spectral decompositions, and (ii) diagonal kernels of the form $K(x,x')=k(x,x')T$, where $k$ is a scalar-valued kernel and $T$ is a positive operator on the output space. This broad setting induces expressive vector-valued reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces (RKHSs) that generalize the classical $K=kI$ paradigm, thereby enabling rich structural modeling with rigorous theoretical guarantees. To address target operators lying outside the RKHS, we introduce vector-valued interpolation spaces to precisely quantify misspecification error. Within this framework, we establish dimension-free polynomial convergence rates, demonstrating that nonlinear operator learning can overcome the curse of dimensionality. The use of general operator-valued kernels further allows us to derive rates for intrinsically nonlinear operator learning, going beyond the linear-type behavior inherent in diagonal constructions of $K=kI$. Importantly, this framework accommodates a wide range of operator learning tasks, ranging from integral operators such as Fredholm operators to architectures based on encoder-decoder representations. Moreover, we validate its effectiveness through numerical experiments on the two-dimensional Navier-Stokes equations.

title: ALNS for Tugboat Scheduling in Inland Waterway
comments: It's written so poorly, my bad
summary: This paper focuses on the barges shipping problem, also known as the tugboats scheduling problem, within the context of a scenario where a single tugboat has the capacity to tow multiple barges and conduct multiple trips in a drop-and-pull mode during a daily work shift. The problem is mathematically formalized as mixed-integer programming models. To tackle real-world-sized problem instances, an adaptive large neighborhood search (ALNS) algorithm integrated with a decoding mathematical model is proposed. When applied to large-scale instances, the ALNS algorithm showcases performance superiority over the strengthened mathematical model.
